title: Just Imagine Stan Lee Creating the DC Universe Book 1 TPB DC 2002 Jim Lee Kubert
conditionDescription: Covers bright with light edge wear; page edges toned, with a small nick on the page block. Binding intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Just Imagine Stan Lee Creating the DC Universe: Book One, trade paperback (DC Comics, 2002), ISBN 1-56389-891-8. Collects Just Imagine Stan Lee with Joe Kubert Creating Batman, with Jim Lee Creating Wonder Woman, with John Buscema Creating Superman, and with Dave Gibbons Creating Green Lantern, plus Secret Files profile pages, all the Adam Hughes back covers, and artist sketches and commentary. $19.95 cover price. (Stan Lee signature on the cover is the printed logo.)

Condition: covers bright with light edge wear; page edges toned, with a small nick on the page block (see edge photos). Binding intact.

Ships in a protective mailer.
